cards.title: split() cuts text into words
cards.body: `text.split()` cuts a string at spaces and gives back a list of words. Extra spaces are ignored.

hi.title: split() text ko words mein kaatta hai
hi.body: `text.split()` string ko spaces par kaatta hai aur words ki list deta hai. Extra spaces ignore ho jaate hain.

cards.title: Looping over words
cards.body: A `for` loop can walk through each word in that list.
cards.code:
for w in "big blue sea".split():
    print(w[0])

hi.title: Words par loop
hi.body: `for` loop us list ke har word se guzar sakta hai.

cards.title: Building a string
cards.body: Start with an empty string `""` and add to it with `+=`. Looping over a string gives you one character at a time.
cards.code:
result = ""
for ch in "abc":
    result += ch * 2
print(result)

hi.title: String banana
hi.body: Khaali string `""` se shuru karo aur `+=` se usme jodte jao. String par loop chalao toh ek baar mein ek character milta hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print each word on its own line, but crashes with a `TypeError`. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: Line 1 forgot the brackets. `split()` calls the method; without `()`, `words` is the method itself, not a list of words.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse har word alag line mein print karna chahiye, par yeh `TypeError` dekar crash hota hai. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: Line 1 mein brackets bhool gaye. `split()` method ko call karta hai; `()` ke bina `words` khud method hai, words ki list nahi.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: split() ignores the double space and finds 3 words.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: split() double space ko ignore karta hai aur 3 words dhoondta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read a full name and print its initials in capital letters, with no spaces: `ada lovelace` becomes `AL`. Words may be separated by more than one space.
exercise.promptHi: Poora naam padho aur uske initials capital letters mein print karo, bina spaces ke: `ada lovelace` ka `AL` banega. Words ke beech ek se zyada space ho sakte hain.
